kmclifetime.help: Kinetic Monte Carlo of excitons (or other carriers) with site-dependent lifetimes and site exclusion in periodic boundary conditions: lifetime, diffusion length, decay sites, occupations; for one exciton also the exact values
kmclifetime.label: calc:kmclifetime

lifetimefile.help: XML file with the lifetime of every site: <lifetimes><site id="0">1e-9</site>...</lifetimes> (seconds; ignored segment types may be left out)

trajectoryfile.help: File with one line per decay: time, lifetime, hops, decay segment, displacement (empty: none)

numberofinsertions.help: Number of decays to simulate in total (0: exact values only)

runs.help: Number of independent runs, in parallel with OpenMP; the decays are distributed over them

seed.help: Integer to initialise the random number generator

numberofcarriers.help: Number of carriers present at a time; a decayed carrier is replaced at once

injectionpattern.help: Name pattern that specifies on which sites carriers are created. Use the wildcard '*' to create them on any site.

injectionmethod.help: random: creation sites are selected randomly among the free ones

occfile.help: File with the occupation probabilities (summed over carriers)

decayprobfile.help: Optional file with per-site decay probabilities: local ratios k/(k+out), k/(k+in), the KMC decay fractions and the exact ones for one carrier

resultfile.help: Main results as 'key value unit' lines in SI units (empty: none)

exact.help: Also compute the exact lifetime, diffusion length and decay probabilities of one carrier (sparse linear systems)

waitingtime.help: Waiting-time method: exponential (static rates) or thinning (time-dependent rates with upper bounds)

maxrealtime.help: Maximum wall-clock time of each run

ignoresegments.help: Segment types (wildcards, separated by commas or spaces) without hops to or from them

carrierenergy.help: Record the mean site energy of the carriers in run 0

alpha.help: Weight of the newest value in the exponential average
